name: Motion LO 01
source:
This is a voiced game that colors and animates four different stories from doujinshi artists:

1. A 16 page doujin "Mayu" by Wanyanaguda (from COMIC LO 2002-10)
2. A 14 page doujin "Inncho -Before-" by Oohara Kyutarou (from COMIC LO 2002-10)
3. A 15 page doujin "Inncho -After-" by Oohara Kyutarou (from COMIC LO 2002-10)
4. A 16 page doujin "Subject Actress" by OKINA (from COMIC LO 2002-10)
5. A 6 page doujin "Kanako-chan Denwa Soudanshitsu" by SH@RP (from COMIC LO 2002-10)
translation:
这是一款有声游戏，为同人艺术家的四个不同故事着色并制作动画：

1. Wanyanaguda的16页同人作品“Mayu”（摘自COMIC LO 2002-10）
2. 大原久太郎的14页同人作品《Inncho -Before-》（摘自COMIC LO 2002-10）
3. 大原久太郎的15页同人作品《Inncho -After-》（摘自COMIC LO 2002-10）
4. OKINA的16页同人《女主角》（来自COMIC LO 2002-10）
5. SH@RP的6页同人作品《Kanako-chan Denwa Soudanshitsu》（摘自COMIC LO 2002-10）
